gaps.explanation: p9 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints enterprise columns Electric, Water, Sewer, Trash and Sales Tax (Sales Tax column all '-' except the restatement) with no schedule of their own; detail[] has no business-type lines. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 1,787,991 + interest income 1,216 = 1,789,207. Per column: Electric 1,258,413 + 817 + 1,156 = 1,260,386; Water 277,369 + 7,994 + 60 = 285,423; Sewer 146,438 + 993 = 147,431; Trash 95,967. Sum 1,789,207 = statement.
